subsystems.name: Model layer
subsystems.role: the reasoning engine that reads a task, decides the next action and writes the result.

subsystems.name: Tool layer
subsystems.role: lets the agent actually do things instead of only talking.

subsystems.name: Knowledge layer
subsystems.role: grounds decisions in company data rather than model memory.

subsystems.name: Orchestration layer
subsystems.role: runs the loop of plan, act, observe, revise, and hands work between agents.

subsystems.name: Memory
subsystems.role: keeps context across steps and across sessions.

subsystems.name: Guardrails and oversight
subsystems.role: stops the agent doing damage or inventing facts.

subsystems.name: Evaluation and observability
subsystems.role: measures whether the agent is actually getting the process right.
parts: regression scores after model or prompt changes

buildSteps.title: Map the process
buildSteps.detail: Write down the current workflow step by step, including every system touched, the documents involved, the decision rules, and the exceptions that humans handle today.

buildSteps.title: Choose one narrow slice
buildSteps.detail: Pick a task with clear success criteria, high volume and tolerable cost of error — for example triaging incoming invoices or drafting first-line support replies.

buildSteps.title: Define the tools
buildSteps.detail: Wrap each system the task needs as a narrow, well-described function with typed inputs and outputs, rather than giving the agent broad database access.

buildSteps.title: Build retrieval
buildSteps.detail: Index the policies, product data and past cases the task depends on, chunk them sensibly, and require the agent to cite the source it used.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the agent loop
buildSteps.detail: Wire the model to the tools with an explicit loop: it proposes an action, the system executes it, the result is fed back, and it continues until a stop condition is met.

buildSteps.title: Add memory and state
buildSteps.detail: Persist intermediate results so a long process survives a crash, and store resolved cases so similar work gets faster.

buildSteps.title: Insert guardrails
buildSteps.detail: Require approval above a value threshold, restrict which tools can be called, block irreversible actions without confirmation, and cap the number of loop iterations.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate against the old process
buildSteps.detail: Run the agent and the human baseline over a held-out set of real cases and compare accuracy, handling time and escalation rate before going live.

buildSteps.title: Deploy narrowly, then widen
buildSteps.detail: Start in shadow mode where the agent's suggestion is only compared to the human's, then let it act with review, then extend to adjacent steps.

prerequisites.tech: Large language models with reliable tool calling
prerequisites.why: the core capability — emitting a structured call and using the returned result — is what separates an agent from a chatbot.
processes depend on company-specific facts the model was never trained on.

prerequisites.tech: Machine-readable APIs for the systems of record
prerequisites.why: agents can only act where an interface exists; older ERP and mainframe systems often need wrappers first.
many tasks need the agent to run a script or click through a UI, which must be isolated from production.
multi-step failures are hard to find without step-level logs and repeatable task tests.

prerequisites.tech: Identity, permissions and audit for autonomous actions
prerequisites.why: an agent needs its own scoped credentials and a defensible record of what it did.

pathway.milestone: single-process agents that draft, extract or route work with a human approving every consequential action
pathway.unlocks: measurable time savings in support, finance and back-office queues.

pathway.milestone: agents that finish a whole transaction end to end, including retries and escalations, under spend and policy limits
memory that persists across sessions and teams, so an agent improves with resolved cases
pathway.unlocks: consistent decisions instead of knowledge locked in individual staff.

pathway.milestone: supervised fleets of agents that hand work to each other across departments, with a complete audit trail
pathway.unlocks: a genuine step change in operating cost — contingent on reliability, security and clear lines of accountability.
